detectors.name: Unusually fast high-severity closures
detectors.method: Leave-one-entity-out conformal p-value per case vs peer cases of the same severity and alert type; entity count tested with a beta-binomial peer model
regulations: SEBI CSCRF - SOC functional efficacy: Detective Effectiveness
NCIIPC guidelines - incident handling

detectors.name: 24x7 claim vs night-time reality
detectors.method: Share of night-opened (00-06h) high/critical cases acknowledged after > 60 min, for entities that declare 24x7 monitoring
regulations: SEBI CSCRF - 'Whether monitoring through SOC is done round-the-clock?'
RBI IT-GRCA 2023 - 24x7 SOC

detectors.name: Regulatory reporting beyond 6 hours
detectors.method: Share of high/critical true positives with no CERT-In report or a report > 6 h after the first alert
regulations: CERT-In Directions 2022 - report incidents within 6 hours
CEA 2024 - reporting to CERT-In / NCIIPC / CSIRT-Power

detectors.name: Threat intelligence not applied
detectors.method: Share of human-handled cases without IOC / threat-intel enrichment; beta-binomial vs peers
regulations: SEBI CSCRF - 'Whether threat intelligence is received and acted upon?'

detectors.name: Critical cases closed without escalation
detectors.method: Beta-binomial test of the unescalated share of closed critical cases vs peers
regulations: SEBI CSCRF - Detective Effectiveness
CEA 2024 - Cyber Crisis Management Plan escalation

detectors.name: Template / copy-paste investigation notes
detectors.method: Near-duplicate clustering (char 3-5-gram cosine >= 0.9, cluster >= 5); beta-binomial vs peers
regulations: SEBI CSCRF - 'Whether qualified personnel are deployed in SOC?'

detectors.name: Acknowledged but not investigated
detectors.method: Closed high/critical cases with no 'investigate' workflow event; beta-binomial vs peers
regulations: SEBI CSCRF - 'Whether IOCs are processed by SOC?'
NCIIPC guidelines - incident handling

detectors.name: Workflow non-conformance
detectors.method: Declarative workflow constraints (triage before close, escalation recorded, containment for true positives, remediation recorded); beta-binomial vs peers
regulations: SEBI CSCRF - Policy Compliance (approved SOPs)
RBI IT-GRCA 2023 - SOC process controls

detectors.name: SLA-threshold bunching (metric gaming)
detectors.method: Bunching estimator: excess mass of critical closures just below the SLA vs a polynomial counterfactual (Chetty et al. 2011; Kleven 2016)
regulations: SEBI CSCRF - Detective Effectiveness (metric integrity)

detectors.name: Repeat alerts without remediation
detectors.method: Closed high/critical true positives followed within 14 days by the same rule firing again as a true positive on the same asset; asset-clustered observed-vs-expected test (expected from peers' rates per asset class), read against peers' statistics
regulations: CERT-In Directions 2022 - remediation of reported incidents
NCIIPC guidelines - root-cause remediation

detectors.name: Silent critical assets
detectors.method: Expected alerts per asset from peer rates of the same asset class (restricted to categories the entity's log sources can see); negative-binomial probability of the observed silence over the last quarter
regulations: SEBI CSCRF - Environment Coverage (coverage of assets w.r.t. SOC technologies)

detectors.name: Quiet ATT&CK tactics (visible but absent)
detectors.method: Expected alert count per supportable tactic from peer tactic mix; Poisson probability of the observed absence
regulations: SEBI CSCRF - 'Whether SOC rules and use-cases detect relevant attacks?'

detectors.name: Blind ATT&CK tactics (cannot be seen)
detectors.method: Deterministic: declared log sources cannot support any detection for tactics that most peers can see
regulations: SEBI CSCRF - 'Quality of logs ingested in SOC (source, frequency, verbosity)'
SEBI CSCRF - monitoring of network traffic and endpoints

detectors.name: Detector decay (exclusion ratchet)
detectors.method: Per detection rule: late-vs-early volume collapse compared with the same rule at peers (conditional binomial)
regulations: SEBI CSCRF - Detective Effectiveness (rule tuning governance)

detectors.name: Missing case records (submission completeness)
detectors.method: Share of high/critical alerts with no case record; beta-binomial vs peers; late submissions reported

detectors.name: Log-retention gap
detectors.method: Deterministic: submitted history shorter than 180 days or containing gaps > 7 days
regulations: CERT-In Directions 2022 - 180-day rolling log retention
DPDP Rules 2025 - processing logs >= 1 year

detectors.name: Clock integrity violations
detectors.method: Deterministic: acknowledgements timestamped before the case was opened
regulations: CERT-In Directions 2022 - clock synchronisation to NIC/NPL NTP

detectors.name: Red-team techniques missed
detectors.method: Deterministic: techniques executed by the entity's own red-team exercise with no matching alert (known-positive miss)
regulations: SEBI CSCRF / CEA 2024 - red-team exercises and drills

detectors.name: Divergence from its synthetic twin
detectors.method: Synthetic control (Abadie et al. 2010): a weighted blend of peers that tracks the entity's monthly share of likely-superficial cases in the first half-year; the post-period gap is ranked against placebo twins of every peer
regulations: SEBI CSCRF - SOC functional efficacy (sustained performance)
NCIIPC guidelines - continuous improvement

log_sources.edr: EDR (process creation, module load, file events)
